method: Generation 1 is exactly this site's citation classification: every paper the Citations panel records as extending a COMMIT paper, using it as a tool, or adopting its idea. Later generations were traced through Semantic Scholar and admitted only with a quoted sentence showing the dependence and that it carries the line's idea; where a later paper also cites a COMMIT paper directly, the site's classification decides. The tracing finds an estimated 55–60% of true descendants, so later generations are lower bounds. Research areas are assigned from title and venue.
